name: Man vs. Gary
storyline:
You are one man in one small boat with one bow. Gary is roughly the size of a district. This is not a fair fight, and everyone involved knows it, including Gary, who finds the whole thing a little tedious.

So you row out, you shoot him until you drown, you file the paperwork, and you row out again. Every arrow counts. The damage stays. Gary remembers. And somewhere around your four hundredth drowning, you start to win.
summary: Row out. Shoot the enormous sea monster. Drown. File the incident report. Do it again, a little angrier each time. A hand-illustrated idle comedy about losing to Gary, a kraken with opinions and a HR complaint, until one day you don't.
